name: Beaufort Wind Force Scale (0–12)
title: Beaufort Wind Force Scale (0–12)
description: The Beaufort scale of wind force from 0 (calm) to 12 (hurricane force), with wind speed in knots, mph, km/h and m/s, typical wave height, and sea and land conditions.

rows.sea_conditions: Ripples with appearance of scales are formed, without foam crests
rows.land_conditions: Direction shown by smoke drift but not by wind vanes

rows.sea_conditions: Small wavelets still short but more pronounced; crests have a glassy appearance but do not break
rows.land_conditions: Wind felt on face; leaves rustle; wind vane moved by wind

rows.sea_conditions: Large wavelets; crests begin to break; foam of glassy appearance; perhaps scattered white horses
rows.land_conditions: Leaves and small twigs in constant motion; light flags extended

rows.sea_conditions: Small waves becoming longer; fairly frequent white horses
rows.land_conditions: Raises dust and loose paper; small branches moved

rows.sea_conditions: Moderate waves taking a more pronounced long form; many white horses are formed; chance of some spray
rows.land_conditions: Small trees in leaf begin to sway; crested wavelets form on inland waters

rows.sea_conditions: Large waves begin to form; the white foam crests are more extensive everywhere; probably some spray
rows.land_conditions: Large branches in motion; whistling heard in telegraph wires; umbrellas used with difficulty

rows.sea_conditions: Sea heaps up and white foam from breaking waves begins to be blown in streaks along the direction of the wind; spindrift begins to be seen
rows.land_conditions: Whole trees in motion; inconvenience felt when walking against the wind

rows.sea_conditions: Moderately high waves of greater length; edges of crests break into spindrift; foam is blown in well-marked streaks along the direction of the wind
rows.land_conditions: Twigs break off trees; generally impedes progress

rows.sea_conditions: High waves; dense streaks of foam along the direction of the wind; sea begins to roll; spray affects visibility
rows.land_conditions: Slight structural damage (chimney pots and slates removed)

rows.sea_conditions: Very high waves with long overhanging crests; resulting foam in great patches is blown in dense white streaks along the direction of the wind; on the whole the surface of the sea takes on a white appearance; rolling of the sea becomes heavy; visibility affected
rows.land_conditions: Seldom experienced inland; trees uprooted; considerable structural damage

rows.sea_conditions: Exceptionally high waves; small- and medium-sized ships might be for a long time lost to view behind the waves; sea is covered with long white patches of foam; everywhere the edges of the wave crests are blown into foam; visibility affected
rows.land_conditions: Very rarely experienced; accompanied by widespread damage

rows.sea_conditions: The air is filled with foam and spray; sea is completely white with driving spray; visibility very seriously affected
